// ================================================================================
//                         HOW TO READ A COMMAND ROW
// ================================================================================
//
//   ID   INPUT   FLAG1      FLAG2      PATTERN   METER   ASSIST   PROJ   DASH
//   390  236C+D  10010101   11000011   211       0       0        0      0
//
//   ID       Number used by HA6 cancels/checks and [ExComCheck]. Do not renumber casually.
//   INPUT    Motion + buttons. Directions use numpad notation: 2 down, 6 forward, etc.
//   PATTERN  HA6 pattern that starts when the command succeeds.
//   METER    Internal hundredths: 10000 = 100 meter; 15000 = 150; 20000 = 200.
//   LAST 3   Assist gate | Projectile-variable gate | Dash-variable gate.
//

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FLAG1: WHEN IT MAY START + CANCEL CLASS

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//
//   Written as: [CLASS][ b6 b5 b4 b3 b2 b1 b0 ]       RIGHTMOST = b0
//
//   CLASS   0 Normal     1 Special     2 EX
//   b6      Guard/Shield cancel
//   b5      Follow-up/Rekka input only
//   b4      Clear the input buffer when this starts
//   b3      Normally cannot be canceled into
//   b2      Allowed while crouching
//   b1      Allowed in the air
//   b0      Allowed while standing
//

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FLAG2: EXTRA COMMAND/CANCEL RULES

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//
//   b7      Unknown
//   b6      Can be kara-canceled into
//   b5      Whiff-cancel-only behavior
//   b4      Guard-cancel only (also requires FLAG1 b6)
//   b3      May cancel into itself
//   b2      May work before the round starts
//   b1      Stricter input timing?       (legacy note; not fully verified)
//   b0      Activates on button release? (legacy note; not fully verified)
//

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// REMEMBER

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//
//   - A HA6 frame condition is too late to stop a 0-frame command.
//     Use a _c gate (Projectile/Dash/ExComCheck) when the move must not start.
//
//   - The METER column checks availability. The move normally uses Effect 2/Type 50
//     to perform the corresponding meter consumption.
//
//   - Use // for notes and keep this file saved as CP932 / Shift-JIS.
//
// ================================================================================

// Pattern ID 0 means that default throw is not defined.

// CHARACTER STATUS / UNIVERSAL ACTION SETTINGS

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AirJumpNum = number of extra air jumps supplied by this command-data file.
// Guard = four guard-related multipliers. Their exact slot order is still unverified.
// CancelSparkPat_Ground/Air = ground/air Circuit Spark (burst) pattern.
// For the air value, 0 disables air Circuit Spark. Other optional Status keys may exist.

[Status]
AirJumpNum = 1 // EXTRA AIR JUMPS: 1
Guard = 0.9, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8 // 4 GUARD VALUES; ORDER UNKNOWN

[ExComCheck]
// ================================================================================
//                     EXCOMCHECK: SHOULD THIS COMMAND START?
// ================================================================================
//
// Each numbered entry (000, 001, 002...) is ONE rule for ONE command.
// If the rule is false, that command is blocked before its first frame.
//
// CHOOSE THE TYPE:
//
//   Type 0   VANILLA EFFECT COLLISION
//            Checks the player's existing collision boxes against a Special Box
//            on one of that player's own spawned effects. P0 selects the player-box
//            mode; P1 selects the effect's Special Box. Exact P0 modes need more study.
//
//   Type 1   VANILLA RANGE COLLISION (RYOUGI USES THIS)
//            Builds a temporary horizontal range box around the player and checks it
//            against a Special Box on that player's own effect/projectile.
//            P0 = range, P1 = Special Box ID, P2 = range shape/mirror mode.
//
//   Type 2   CUSTOM VARIABLE GATE (OUR NEW SYSTEM)
//            Compares one rollback-safe Custom Variable with a number.
//            This is what OD, Max Cancel, Air Move, Shield RC, and SJC gates use here.
//
//   Type 3   HOLD / CHARGE GATE (EXTENDED MELTY)
//            Reads this player's input history. It uses no Custom Variable.
//            P0 = policy*1000 + partitions*10 + stream
//              policy: 0 Transform | 1 Preserve | 2 Break on side switch
//              partitions: 0..63 | 99 unlimited
//              stream: 0 Direction | 1 A | 2 B | 3 C | 4 D | 5 E | 6 F
//            P1 = accepted-input bitmask. Direction bit N accepts numpad N.
//              only 4 = 16 | 1+4+7 = 146 | 3+6+9 = 584
//            P2 = total charge frames | P3 = max internal gap
//            P4 = final release/completion window
//            Example P0=1010: Preserve + 1 partition + Direction stream.
//
// IMPORTANT: P0/P1/P2 mean different things for every Type.
// The Type 2 layout below does NOT describe vanilla Type 0 or Type 1.
//
// READ A TYPE 2 RULE LIKE THIS:
//
//   CheckNum   Which command ID are we allowing/blocking?
//   Type = 2   Use our Custom Variable comparison.
//   P0         Which Custom Variable?
//   P1         Which comparison?  0 == | 1 != | 2 < | 3 <= | 4 > | 5 >=
//   P2         Compare the variable against this number.
//   P3         Whose variable?     0 Self | 1 Opponent | 2 P1 | 3 P2
//   P4 = 0     Reserved. Always leave it at 0.
//
// FORMULA:   CV[P0]  P1  P2
// EXAMPLE:   P0=102, P1=0, P2=0  means  "CV102 must equal 0"
//
// SAME COMMAND TWICE = AND
// If two entries use the same CheckNum, BOTH rules must be true.
// Example: OD SJC checks both "not used yet" AND "enough OD resources".
//
// Num tells the game exactly how many numbered entries exist below.
// Invalid indexes/operators/banks/reserved values safely block the command.
// ================================================================================
Num = 25 // TOTAL CHECKS BELOW: 000 to 024

// OD GATING SYSTEM
// OD MOVE 2: command 390 = 236C+D OD Hop Kick; CV102 == 0 means this OD move has not been used this combo.
000_CheckNum = 390 // MOVE TO ALLOW / BLOCK
000_Type = 2 // CUSTOM VARIABLE CHECK
000_P0 = 102 // VARIABLE: CV102
000_P1 = 0 // TEST: ==
000_P2 = 0 // AGAINST: 0
000_P3 = 0 // READ: SELF
000_P4 = 0 // MUST STAY 0
